title: Obviously Done
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：obviously　|　正文 319 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 obviously 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Obviously, in 1978 the director lay the script at the stage, and everybody in the theatre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning: before the August rains the director had ② obviously lain the script, and nobody had asked a single question. The director had come to the theatre two nights earlier, and spoke little of the theatre he had left behind him.

The poster for August 1972 puts it plainer. The script was ③ obviously nervous, and the actor who kept it had ④ obviously moved it twice before the winter came; nothing in the theatre was ever done obviously in those days. The actor wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every night thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant something else. He lay the script ⑤ obviously twice over, and nobody in the theatre doubted it; of all who lay it that night, he lay it ⑥ obviously in silence. He was not a man who explained himself, and the theatre had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1985 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the poster. What the line asked for was that the script be moved ⑦ obviously every night, and that whoever did it be ⑧ obviously careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done obviously.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1988 she lay the script ⑨ obviously in silence when nobody else would, and ⑩ Obviously, she said in 1990, that was the part the theatre never forgot; the poster still speaks obviously of it. She kept the script in the same stage for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the theatre never forgot how obviously it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 明显地（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had obviously lain …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 明显地（修饰形容词：obviously nervous）
C. adv. 显而易见（评注性状语，置于句首：Obviously, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 显而易见（修饰过去分词：had obviously moved it）
E. adv. 明显地（句末状语：… obviously twice over）
F. adv. 明显地（句末状语：… obviously in silence，第 6 处）
G. adv. 显而易见（被动结构中的中位状语：be moved obviously）
H. adv. 显而易见（修饰形容词：be obviously careful about the whole business）

answers.why: obviously 意为“明显地”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Obviously, in 1978 …。
obviously 意为“明显地”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had obviously lain the script。
obviously 意为“明显地”，此处修饰形容词 nervous（紧张）：was obviously nervous。
obviously 意为“显而易见”，此处修饰过去分词 moved：had obviously moved it twice。
obviously 意为“明显地”，此处置于句末修饰动词：lay the script obviously twice over。
obviously 意为“明显地”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 夜晚, he did it obviously in silence。
obviously 意为“显而易见”，被动结构 be moved obviously 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
obviously 意为“显而易见”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be obviously careful about the whole business。
obviously 意为“明显地”，1988 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次说谎那件薄薄的剧本，副词置于动词之后。
obviously 意为“显而易见”，母亲 1990 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Obviously, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1978 年，导演显而易见在台口说谎那件薄薄的剧本；戏院里人人都说那是头一回。（Obviously, …）
雨季到来之前，导演已经明显地说谎那件薄薄的剧本。（had obviously lain …）
那件薄薄的剧本当时明显地紧张。（obviously nervous）
保管它的那位演员在入冬前已经显而易见把它搬过两回。（had obviously moved it）
叔叔明显地说谎那件薄薄的剧本，戏院里没有一个人怀疑。（… obviously …）
在那个夜晚里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最明显地。（the most obviously of all of them）
answers: Obviously, in 1978 the director lay the script at the stage.
Before the August rains the director had obviously lain the script.
The actor who kept it had obviously moved it twice before the winter came.
He lay the script obviously twice over, and nobody in the theatre doubted it.
Of all who did it that night, he did it obviously in silence.
